rounds.text: Thomas Scott India Ltd is demonstrating phenomenal top-line and bottom-line expansion, with compounded sales growth reaching 77% over the trailing twelve months and profit growth surging by 58% over the same period [E17, E21]. This exceptional operational momentum is backed by stellar historical execution, featuring a 5-year compounded profit growth rate of 184% and a 10-year compounded sales growth of 35% [E14, E19]. Crucially, a discounted cash flow valuation estimates intrinsic value at Rs 528 per share, offering a compelling margin of safety of 42.8% against the current market price of Rs 302 [E45, E46]. Furthermore, return metrics remain robust, evidenced by a 20.5% ROCE and a 16.7% ROE, while domestic institutional investors have increased their stake to 2.45% as of June 2026 [E12, E13, E43]. Management continues to support this growth trajectory by targeting EBITDA margins between 12% to 15% alongside ongoing capacity expansion plans in Sholapur [E77, E81]. Conceded: Promoter holdings have decreased by 17.3 percentage points since September 2023, and operating cash flow was negative Rs 27 Cr in March 2026 [E35, E41].
